usage: Illustrations of drywall work, not photographs of completed LAN projects.
constraints: Five distinct drywall scenes; maximum two visually similar photos; no people; full 3:2 images.

photos.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset: one landscape 3:2 photograph for a premium Estonian drywall contractor website carousel. Create a single photograph, never a collage. Authentic architectural/construction editorial photography, expensive Nordic residential renovation, exceptional craftsmanship, natural daylight, believable perspective and dimensions, subtle real textures, no CGI sheen, no extreme wide angle. Drywall installation must be unmistakable: real gypsum plasterboard, accurately spaced screws, taped and filled joints where appropriate. Clean organized active worksite, attractive bright interior, premium but credible, no generic furnished room where the work cannot be identified. No text, logos, watermarks, comparison panels. Do not add decorative tools everywhere. Wide hero photograph of a beautiful spacious Scandinavian townhouse during late-stage drywall installation. Camera at chest height looking diagonally across the room. Main subject is precisely built pale grey gypsum-board partition walls with one clean rectangular doorway and integrated recessed niche, white joint compound bands and screw heads clearly visible, generous black-framed windows at left overlooking soft green trees, warm daylight across protected subfloor. Elegant clean straight architecture, a discreet stack of boards on the far edge. Walls dominate composition. No people.
